title: Pinched hemisphere with 18-degree opening
description: Quarter spherical shell; R=10, t=0.04, E=6.825e7, nu=0.3; polar angle 18 to 90 degrees.
geometry: 25 nodes; 16 elements. Quarter spherical shell; R=10, t=0.04, E=6.825e7, nu=0.3; polar angle 18 to 90 degrees.
material: E=6.825e+07, nu=0.3; shell thickness=0.04. Consistent benchmark units; displacements in deck length unit, forces in deck force unit, stress in force/length^2

loading: Quarter-model radial point forces: +1 in X and -1 in Y at the equator.

observations: The figure shows the finest qualified companion; the table retains the supplied benchmark and available refinements. Each field dataset and binary file has its own input hash and run receipt.
limits: Linear elasticity and small-displacement equilibrium or linearized bifurcation/modal analysis; this is computational verification, not a material-test validation.
